SEARCH
Package edu.bu.pas.hex.agents

Class ATPZSTreeSearchAgent<T extends ATPZSNode>

java.lang.Object
edu.bu.pas.hex.agents.ATPZSTreeSearchAgent<T>
All Implemented Interfaces:
Agent, TreeSearcher
Direct Known Subclasses:
ATPZSMCTSAgent
public abstract class ATPZSTreeSearchAgent<T extends ATPZSNode> extends Object implements Agent, TreeSearcher
Represents an Agent that chooses Actions using some version of deterministic adversarial tree-search in an "alternating two player" and "zero-sum" settings. This Agent's getAction (which is called by the main game loop) converts the GameView to a Node object using the toNode method, called its treeSearch method on that Node and then returns the Action provided by the getLastAction method of the Node returned by treeSearch.

Note that this Agent is using an arbitrary version of deterministic adversarial tree-search in an alternating two-player zero-sum setting which is why child classes must implement toNode and treeSearch: doing so specifies *which* kind of tree search the child class is implementing.

    • getMaxThiningTimeInMs

      public final long getMaxThiningTimeInMs()
      Returns the number of milliseconds that this agent is allowed to think for per move. If this agent takes longer than this budget of time to think (measured by getAction execution), the game will skip this agent's turn and mark a strike against this agent. If this agent accrues enough strikes then this agent will lose the game.
      Specified by:
      getMaxThiningTimeInMs in interface Agent
      Returns:
      The maximum amount of thinking time that this agent's getAction is allowed to run for.

    • search

      public Node search(GameView game)
      The entry point into your tree search. This method uses your toNode method to get the root node of the game tree and then calls your treeSearch method on that root node and returns whatever node is produced by that method.

      Note that Node objects store an incoming edge (e.g. an Action) as described in class. So the Node you want to return is a *child* of the root node.

      Specified by:
      search in interface TreeSearcher
      Parameters:
      game - The current state of the game.
      Returns:
      The child Node of the root node containing the Action to emit.

    • getAction

      public Action getAction(GameView game)
      Returns the Action this agent wants to take in this turn. The game loop will call this method until the game is solved. Must be a legal action to take or the Action will be discarded and a strike will be issued to this agent.
      Specified by:
      getAction in interface Agent
      Parameters:
      game - The current state of the game.
      Returns:
      The Action the agent wants to take in this turn. Must be a legal action.
